verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a government tax portal, but the evidence pack never documents a keyless or file-number entry path for starting the core filing flow. The only entry evidence is a 'Registar-se ... Iniciar Sessão' (register/sign in) link, which points to account-based access. The informational and customs-parcel pages do not state that the core online flow can be started without an account.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
